name: Maven Robotics mobile manipulator
summary: A wheeled dual-arm mobile manipulator with two 7-degree-of-freedom arms and a small footprint, which reaches to the back of a 48-inch pallet or shelves up to 3 m high with 30 kg; it runs mixed-case palletizing and tote handling for a first production customer in the US.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route found; Maven (Santa Clara, California) offers its robots as a service and works with large manufacturing and logistics firms via a contact form.

specs.label: Payload while reaching
specs.conditions: reach to the back of a 48-in pallet or a shelf up to 3 m high
specs.quote: We can reach to the back of a 48-in. [121.9 cm] pallet or deep into a storage shelf up to 3 m [9.8 ft.] high while carrying 30 kg [66.1 lb.] payloads.

specs.label: Reach height
specs.quote: deep into a storage shelf up to 3 m [9.8 ft.] high

specs.label: Arms
specs.quote: we have two seven degree-of-freedom arms

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: Modular end-of-arm interface: vacuum suction gripper and two-finger parallel gripper
specs.quote: a vacuum suction gripper, and a parallel gripper with two fingers

specs.label: Operating pattern
specs.value: 16 h a day, 5 days a week, up to 99% uptime
specs.quote: It currently has robots running 16 hours a day, five days a week, with up to 99% uptime

notes: Model name not published; Maven calls it its first robot and has built four iterations since 2024; it left stealth with a Series A in September 2026.
Figures come from an interview with the CEO in The Robot Report; Maven's own site gives no specs.

evidence.task: Mixed-case palletizing and tote handling under a production contract with its first customer
